name: SlimeRNG
summary:
Welcome to Slime RNG, a colorful adventure where every roll could change your journey! Discover and collect hundreds of unique slimes, from common companions to incredibly rare creatures waiting to be found. Increase your luck, unlock new eggs, and chase the rarest slimes as your collection grows.
